result:
I’d make it much harder for people to stop seeing each other as fully human.

So much cruelty, indifference, and conflict starts with that one shift: turning someone into a category, an obstacle, or an enemy instead of a person. If empathy were harder to switch off than fear, a lot of other things might begin to repair themselves.
